complexDefinition.stringValue: An account or statement describing in detail an event, situation, or the like, usually as the result of observation, inquiry, etc.

definition.stringValue: A detailed description of an event or situation.

text.stringValue: Подробное описание события или ситуации.
**Report** on the traffic accident was very comprehensive.
The scientist gave a detailed **report** on the lab experiment.
I have to finish my **report** on economic trends.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A formal assessment or examination of something with the possibility or intention of instituting change if necessary.

definition.stringValue: A detailed inspection with intention of possible changes.

text.stringValue: Детальная проверка с намерением возможных изменений.
**Report** on municipal water quality demands immediate action.
The auditor's **report** suggests several improvements to financial processes.
Management needs to review this **report** on employee satisfaction.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A spoken or written description of an event or situation, especially one intended for publication or broadcasting in the media.

definition.stringValue: A detailed description for publication or media broadcast.

text.stringValue: Подробное описание для публикации или медийного вещания.
**Report** on new dietary guidelines drew significant public interest.
National Geographic published a **report** on disappearing bee populations.
Health ministry released a thorough **report** on COVID-19's impact.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An official document or account of a case or matter.

definition.stringValue: An official document describing a case.

text.stringValue: Официальный документ, описывающий дело.
**Report** on the recent outbreak of food poisoning in town.
Geological **report** detailing potential earthquake activity in the region.
Financial auditors completed a comprehensive **report** on the company's finances.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Notification or communication of facts of findings.

text.stringValue: Обмен фактами или результатами исследования.
**Report** highlighted elevated cholesterol levels in patients.
Scientists published a **report** on the benefits of exercise.
The investigator's **report** uncovered several instances of fraud.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An oral or written description of particular events or situations; narrative.

text.stringValue: Подробное описание событий.
**Report** on the local car accident surfaced today.
The mayor's **report** on poverty alleviation is insightful.
A comprehensive **report** detailed the company's quarterly earnings.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A detailed document or statement providing an account of something.

definition.stringValue: A document giving an account of something.

text.stringValue: Документ, содержащий описание чего-либо.
**Report** suggested ways for optimizing our marketing resources.
The commission published a detailed **report** on the accident.
She prepared an annual financial **report** for the company.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Official or legal papers containing detailed information about a particular subject or event.

text.stringValue: Юридические документы с подробной информацией.
**The solicitor prepared the report detailing the lawsuit's progress.**
**A comprehensive report carefully documented the property boundaries and usage.**
**The police issued a report about the road traffic accident.**

complexDefinition.stringValue: A teacher's written assessment of a pupil's work, progress, and conduct sent home to a parent or guardian.

definition.stringValue: A teacher's written assessment sent home.

text.stringValue: Письменная оценка учителя, отправленная домой.
**Report** arrived, confirming his impressive academic achievements.
Her worst fears materialized in the form of a poor **report**.
The End-of-Year **report** reflected Susan's drastic improvements.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A detailed account or statement.

text.stringValue: Детальное изложение.
**Report** on quarterly earnings released by the company.
Scientific **report** confirms the effective treatment for cancer.
The police filed a crime **report** for further investigation.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An explosive noise.

text.stringValue: Взрывной звук.
There was a loud **report** from the firecracker.
The gun's **report** echoed throughout the valley.
He jumped at the sudden **report** of the fireworks.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To give a description or account of, or to make known formally, officially, or publicly.

text.stringValue: Описывать или объявлять.
**Report** all accidents to the site manager immediately.
All cases of theft must be **reported** to the police.
The doctor **reported** significant improvement in the patient's condition.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Present oneself formally as having arrived at a particular place or as ready to do something.

definition.stringValue: To officially announce arrival or readiness.

text.stringValue: Официально объявить о прибытии или готовности.
**Report** to the reception desk upon your arrival.
The soldiers were instructed to **report** for duty at dawn.
He was told to **report** to his supervisor after completing the task.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Express an opinion or reaction concerning a subject.

definition.stringValue: To state an opinion or reaction.

text.stringValue: Высказать мнение или реакцию.
**Report** your honest feelings about the new rules.
He didn't **report** satisfaction with the job performance.
I'll **report** my feedback after testing the product.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To submit or relate the details of an incident or case.

definition.stringValue: To provide details of an incident.

text.stringValue: Предоставить подробности о происшествии.
**Report** any suspicious activity to the local police immediately.
She will **report** her findings to the board on Monday.
He **report**ed the theft immediately to his insurance company.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To inform someone of something, typically in a formal or official manner.

text.stringValue: Официально сообщить кому-то.
**Report** the accident to the police immediately.
He was told to **report** his findings to the director.
She always **report**s cases of misconduct to her supervisor.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To accuse or denounce.

text.stringValue: Обвинять кого-то.
**Report** him for stealing your lunch.
She decided to **report** the fraudulent behavior to the authorities.
I had to **report** my neighbor's noise violations.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To write down a detailed record of certain events.

text.stringValue: Записывать подробное событие.
**Report** the incident to the police immediately.
The journalist should **report** on the ongoing protests.
Remember to **report** any suspicious activities to your manager.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To express a piece of information about.

definition.stringValue: To share a piece of information.

text.stringValue: Поделиться частью информации.
**Report** your observations to the team leader immediately.
Peter had to **report** the accident to the police station.
She needed to **report** the stolen purse to her bank.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To make a noise.

text.stringValue: Издавать громкий шум.
The old cannon **reported** loudly across the battlefield.
Thunder **reported** deafeningly, startling everyone in the vicinity.
The backfire of the car **reported** through the quiet neighborhood.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To note or record in writing.

text.stringValue: Записывать в письменной форме.
**Report** your findings after the lab experiment.
The teacher asked me to **report** my assignment progress.
He was asked to **report** on the meeting outcomes.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A sudden loud noise of or like an explosion or gunfire.

definition.stringValue: A loud noise like an explosion.

text.stringValue: Громкий шум, напоминающий взрыв.
The car's backfire **reported** across the quiet street.
Cannon fire **reported** ominously in the distance.
The tree **reported** loudly when lightning struck it.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To carry back and repeat to another or others.

text.stringValue: Повторять информацию другим.
**Report** back immediately with your findings.
She was asked to **report** the incident to her supervisor.
The detective will **report** his progress to the chief.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To make a written note or report of.

text.stringValue: Сделать письменную заметку.
**Report** all damages immediately after you notice them.
Jenny will **report** the meeting's minutes tomorrow.
We are expected to **report** any suspicious activity.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To complain about.

text.stringValue: Жаловаться.
**Report** his rude behavior to the school principal.
She decided to **report** the issue to customer service.
They chose to **report** the noise disturbance to local police.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To serve or work as a reporter.

definition.stringValue: To work as a news reporter.

text.stringValue: Работать репортером в новостях.
**Report** on the local election results tonight.
Tomorrow, I'll **report** on the charity gala for the newspaper.
He was assigned to **report** on the sports event.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To announce or relate as the result of investigation.

text.stringValue: Объявить результат расследования.
**Report** showed no traces of poison in the victim's body.
Scientific study **reports** a link between sugar and heart disease.
Forensic team **reported** fingerprints match with the accused suspect.
